statements.status_notes: This advisory is a stored XSS class issue in the Prometheus interactive web UI assets under web/ui. The adapter container does not ship or execute the Prometheus web UI or its frontend bundles.

CVE-2026-42154 affects unauthenticated requests to the Prometheus remote-read HTTP endpoint (/api/v1/read) on a running Prometheus server. This image does not run the Prometheus server or expose that API surface; github.com/prometheus/prometheus is linked only as a Go dependency for metrics-related libraries used by the adapter.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus HTTP configuration endpoint (/-/config) when Azure AD remote-write OAuth is configured, exposing client_secret because the field was not modeled as a Secret type. The keda-metrics-apiserver image ships only the metrics adapter binary built from cmd/adapter; it does not run the Prometheus server or expose /-/config or remote-write storage endpoints.

DHI KEDA images compile worker binaries from kedacore/keda, not the Prometheus monolithic server. This issue is in Prometheus web UI rendering for the standalone server; the shipped binaries do not serve that UI or Prometheus query/admin front-end.

DHI KEDA images compile worker binaries from kedacore/keda, not the Prometheus monolithic server. This issue targets Prometheus server remote-read ingestion paths; those listeners are not run by the shipped binaries.

DHI KEDA images compile operator, metrics-adapter, or admission-webhook mains from kedacore/keda. This issue is the Prometheus server /-/config API leaking Azure AD remote-write OAuth client_secret; those Prometheus daemon HTTP surfaces are not started or exposed by these worker binaries.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
